description: This file defines the SchemaHelper class, which provides utility methods for managing and modifying database schemas using Doctrine DBAL. It includes methods for creating tables, adding, changing, dropping columns, and managing foreign keys and constraints, specifically for use in the OrangeHRM installer.

classes.name: SchemaHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing and modifying database schemas with Doctrine DBAL, including creating tables, adding, altering, dropping columns, managing foreign keys, and handling constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SchemaHelper with a Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine DBAL Connection object used by the helper.

methods.name: dropColumn
methods.description: Drops a specific column from a table.

methods.name: dropColumns
methods.description: Drops multiple columns from a table.

methods.name: getTableColumn
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific column in a table.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager instance.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to a table with specified type and options.

methods.name: addOrChangeColumns
methods.description: Adds new columns or modifies existing columns based on provided options.

methods.name: changeColumn
methods.description: Changes the properties of an existing column.

methods.name: renameColumn
methods.description: Renames an existing column in a table.

methods.name: dropForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign key constraints from a table.

methods.name: addForeignKey
methods.description: Adds a foreign key constraint to a table.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table object with specified charset, collation, and engine options.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKey
methods.description: Drops the primary key of a table.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the native PDO connection object from the Doctrine connection.

methods.name: disableConstraints
methods.description: Disables foreign key constraints for the database session.

methods.name: enableConstraints
methods.description: Enables foreign key constraints for the database session.

methods.name: columnExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific column exists in a table.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops an index from a table.
